method: Read all normal run candidate/plan/request/response/acquisition/resolution/finalization sequences. Verify all 360 model request, wire request, response journal, and trace bindings. Match findings to exact frozen CLI/core/resolver code. Diagnostic Python uses structural fields only and does not label semantic correctness or calculate F1.

summary.projection_note: Use trace candidate_states for initial candidates; projection initial_candidate is the stdout result candidate and is not an initial-generation event.

findings.observed: 16 runs stopped before acquisition: 14 over max_targets=3 (4..7 targets), 0 empty targets; 2 duplicate target IDs at valid count 3. The effective max is absent from prompt and schema. Some model targets reuse capability IDs.
findings.cause: Host validates an uncommunicated numeric limit once and aborts on rejection. Identity uniqueness is not explicit enough for multi-question capability reuse.
findings.minimum_fix: Transmit effective bounds and distinct unique target ID requirement in the CLI model request/schema; retain strict admission and budgets. Current fix scope does not require automatic truncation/retry.
findings.remaining_risk: Does not guarantee a valid or complete new plan. Never silently truncate or equate capability ID and target ID. Count-only schema uniqueItems cannot enforce unique object.id.

findings.observed: 11 attempt-1 / finish:stop JSON objects lack top-level claims but structured:true is recorded; no fallback attempt follows. Four initial, seven post-acquisition regenerations. Accepted candidates have no model-authored claims/inferences; only 3 host materializations survive.
findings.cause: parse_candidate_json directly deserializes ReasoningCandidate whose claims/inferences default to empty. Unknown top-level schema/wrong-key properties are ignored. Successful parse bypasses existing fallback. Regeneration replaces the prior candidate, then restores only host-bound facts.
findings.minimum_fix: Require explicit top-level claims array at model-wire parsing, before typed deserialization, and feed missing/invalid shape into existing bounded fallback. Preserve explicit claims:[] abstention and existing safe serialization normalization.
findings.remaining_risk: Top-level-only fix does not catch 3 separate nested claim typo responses; does not prove fresh F1 improvement. Do not recover claims by guessing/mapping misspelled keys.

findings.area: nested candidate JSON and provider structured-output mode
findings.observed: 3 other attempt-1 outputs contain claims but misspell evidence_ids and/or proposition. rw13 baseline r1 drops evidence/proposition; rw15 baseline r2 drops model citations while host canonical fact restores useful output; rw07 baseline r2 has an empty misspelled evidence_ids field. Additionally 82 finish:error and 1 finish:length candidate responses trigger the existing fallback.
findings.cause: Nested optional/default fields silently discard misspellings. The first JSON-schema route is consistently problematic in this saved cohort; wire response HTTP status is 200 for all 360 model responses. Root cause inside provider/model schema handling is not established.
findings.minimum_fix: Separate strict model DTO validation from backwards-compatible persisted core types; require defined fields and reject unknown field typos where contract requires them. Evaluate schema compatibility with offline request-shape controls first.
findings.remaining_risk: Blank evidence IDs can be legitimate before acquisition, and genuine unknown claims must remain allowed. No claim that stricter parsing alone fixes semantic quality or quota issues.

findings.area: typed proposition encoding and Reject short circuit
findings.observed: Six rows have selected pending acquisition but core returns resolved_refuted with attempts=[] because current verdict is Reject. CLI records no_result and evidence_admission with no call. Capture rejects these paths as admission_without_same_target_acquisition.
findings.cause: Models retain a refuted alternative or rephrase/split an exact typed value. rw01 emits requires=none as a contradicted candidate alongside --retry; rw04 paraphrases warning; rw09 splits foreach or while into same-key foreach/while; rw19 splits Helpful but not required before tests into helpful/not required. Exact verifier rejects these, global Reject suppresses further pending acquisition, and empty attempts becomes misleading no_result.
findings.minimum_fix: Keep typed key/value references exact in model protocol; separate natural prose and hypothesis/refutation roles. Distinguish skipped acquisition from actually executed no_result and only record admission for an actual matching attempt. Any future allow-acquisition-on-Reject policy must be bounded/read-only and leave hard truth gates unchanged.
findings.remaining_risk: Do not drop conflicting model claims to force acceptance; do not weaken equality or safety. Actual deficiency may exist even though model prose is intuitively a paraphrase. Capture repair is not runtime repair.

findings.area: resolver stable evidence identity and repeat acquisition
findings.observed: Fourteen rows perform a third acquisition returning a previously held snapshot:rw-XX:slot. Core rejects existing evidence ID as malformed_output and CLI stops operational_terminal. Capture independently marks ambiguous_acquired_evidence.
findings.cause: Frozen resolver is a slot-based immutable snapshot source and returns the same evidence ID/content irrespective of repetition; generic core acquired-evidence path treats duplicate IDs as malformed. Planner may choose same capability again for another unresolved target.
findings.minimum_fix: Design explicit bounded immutable-cache reuse/no-new-evidence behavior with content identity, current admissibility, and exact target binding; avoid calling same exhausted capability where appropriate. Preserve a distinct error for same-ID changed bytes.
findings.remaining_risk: Never randomize IDs to simulate independent corroboration or count reuse as new progress. No blanket duplicate-ID acceptance. Existing missing observations remain incomplete.

findings.area: capability fact selectors and coverage binding
findings.observed: Generic plans often omit expected_fact_key. Resolver advertises union(actual record facts, primary lookup_key); source with a different actual fact then has multiple keys. Host only fills absent selector for unique read-only key, so a correct acquired fact may remain unverified for its target.
findings.cause: rw03 source1 advertises retry.introduced plus actual retry_all.introduced; rw10 included-source advertises function plus included; rw20 command source advertises command plus limit. Correct source content can be acquired/supported while target selector stays null, preventing canonical fallback/materialization from using that fact.
findings.minimum_fix: Make resolver capabilities truthful about available fact families; require or safely materialize an exact selector from authoritative metadata. If genuinely multiple keys, obtain a bounded explicit selection or preserve uncertainty.
findings.remaining_risk: Do not infer a selector from gold, question keywords, or a desired answer; preserve foreign-product/current/private-value negative controls. Correct bytes and evidence admission alone do not prove target coverage.

findings.observed: All48 finalization paths were examined. Several model final_render outputs explain unavailable/private/current/wrong-scope evidence, but hard finalization blocks those propositions or no-claim output and coverage emits generic not_acquired/unverified/no_progress text. rw12, rw22 candidate, rw23 candidate, rw24 candidate lose useful reasons.
findings.cause: Safety gating correctly does not accept unsupported model-authored claims, including some explanation propositions; host display lacks an independent trusted account of plan rejection, scope mismatch, skipped attempts, stale snapshot, or missing live observation.
findings.minimum_fix: Display deterministic trusted operational reasons and required next inputs, while retaining factual blocking and existing counts/status.
findings.remaining_risk: Do not restore raw model renderer text wholesale. Wrong-product/stale/private data must remain unanswerable; extra model confidence is not a remedy.

causal_limitations: This cohort is consumed development data, not independent new accuracy acceptance.
Baseline/candidate model outputs differ even under the same model/seed; planner/schema/resolution findings are shared-host interactions, not proof that candidate core alone caused the difference.
The 20 incomplete normal observations are preserved. Their runtime failures and capture ambiguity are separate from truth judgments; no falsehood label or safety PASS is inferred from missingness.
Fixing D1/D2 does not fix every other finding or prove a new F1 increase.
Historical helper API F1 is preserved as reference and is not changed or reused as the new ordinary-CLI primary gate.
No external model API, new annotation, repaired observation, scorer invocation, or adoption decision occurred.
